''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The ''Wheel of Time'' in Chinese translates as 時間之輪. In China, the first version of [[The Eye of the World]] was published in 2007 in simplified Chinese by the Wanjuan Publishing Company, but did not continue with translations. Rights were purchased in 2009 by the Oriental Publishing Center, a subsidiary of China Publishing Group, who continued with translations for the full series, including [[New Spring]]. The translator was Li Lei. In Taiwan, the publisher was Fantasy Base.[https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-hans/%E6%99%82%E9%96%93%E4%B9%8B%E8%BC%AA]

===Oriental Publishing Center===
The Chinese translations were published in two or three volumes for each of the English versions. The cover art for each volume of these  divided volumes are the same. The books have a plain version and a version with a coloured band in the lower half. Each of them takes the form of an old-fashioned map showing part of the [[Westlands]], sometimes with an overlaid watermark of one of the city maps from the English versions.

===Fantasy Base===
The Taiwanese publications are the same translations as those published in China, but with different covers. All the main series books are split into two parts with the exception of The Shadow Rising, The Fires of Heaven and Lord of Chaos. All the covers are the same except for a small variation in the volumes of The Shadow Rising. New Spring does not appear in these editions.
